values.note: Standard back-in/pull-through sites $30 a night on weeknights, $35 on Saturdays (2027 April and June quotes alike); the one double site (36) is $60/$70. Over 4 adults $5 each per night; extra vehicle $10. Seniors 62+, military and public safety 10% off each (any two may be combined). Changes $10; reservation/service fees are mentioned but no amount is shown before checkout.

fees.source: https://pc.bookmysites.com/reservations/checkout-availability (site types 'Back In/ Pull Thru Sites' per_night 30 on 2027-04-13 and 2027-06-08, 35 on 2027-04-17 and 2027-06-12; 'Double Sites' 60/70; 'Minimum Stay Sites' 30/35; per_adult_charge 5 over max_adults 4; per_extra_vehicle_charge 10.00) + https://www.hartcountyga.gov/PaynesCreek.html ('Seniors (age 62 &up), Military, and Public Safety discounts are available at 10% each', 'Changes ... are charged a $10 change fee'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 10% each for seniors 62+, military and public safety; any two can be combined; the named person must be present at check-in.

values.note: 44 public sites plus 2 attendant sites; most are pull-throughs. The engine's unit-size ranges run 25 ft (sites 16, 20) and 27 ft (1, 2) up to 55 ft (27); every RV site takes a 23-ft unit.

values.note: County's bookmysites engine (public, site map with live availability). Books up to two years ahead. 14 nights max, then 7 days away before a new reservation. Sites 7, 8, 23, 24, 33 and 34 have a 7-night minimum; all other sites none. Cancellations under 30 days lose 50%. Entrance gate closes at dark; gate code given at check-in.

Sites 7, 8, 23, 24, 33 and 34 have a minimum stay of 7 days', 'Cancellations NOT made 30 days prior ... loss of 50%', 'Entrance gate CLOSES at dark') + bookmysites (allow_booking_upto_days 730, stay_limit 14, 'Minimum Stay Sites' min_stay 7, other types 0), read 2026-10-30

note: Hart County-operated since Jan 2021 on Corps of Engineers land leased to the county, on Hartwell Lake's Tugaloo arm; ~37 sites waterfront historically. Two swim beaches, boat ramp with courtesy dock, a 9-mile multi-purpose trail (volunteer-run, separate from the campground). Well water: no washing cars or campers, and the county asks campers to use water sparingly. --Claude
summary: County page + its public bookmysites engine: $30 weeknight / $35 Saturday (2027), 44 sites (most pull-through, up to 55 ft; all fit 23 ft), full water + electric, showers, dump, open Mar 1 - Oct 31, books 2 years ahead, 14-night max, six sites carry a 7-night minimum; seniors/military/public-safety 10%. Added fees, discounts, sites lengths, booking details. Amperage (50, from the old note) not stated by the county or engine - left. Phone 706-377-3456 confirmed. Pin sits on the campground's peninsula (fine). Note trimmed.
